product_overview: Lumen is a mobile-first Progressive Web App that provides a live, collaborative wedding photo gallery where guests can capture or upload photos, add dedications, and view a global or personal feed in real time.
core_goals: Zero-friction onboarding with anonymous device identification (no account creation).
Fast, mobile-first camera capture and file upload with preview and dedication text.
Real-time shared gallery view with personal vs global filters and easy save/share options.
Robust fallbacks for older/mobile browser limitations (UUID fallback, flash fallback, Web Share fallback) and clear error states for upload/permissions issues.

features.name: Anonymous Device Identification (Anonymous Auth)
features.description: Generate and persist a unique Device ID for each guest on first load using window.crypto.randomUUID() with a deterministic fallback; ensure Device ID is initialized before navigating to the gallery.
user_flows: Start app -> Check localStorage for Device ID -> Device ID missing -> Attempt window.crypto.randomUUID() -> randomUUID() returns value -> Save Device ID to localStorage -> Proceed to /home

Start app -> Check localStorage for Device ID -> Device ID missing -> Attempt window.crypto.randomUUID() -> randomUUID() undefined -> Run fallback hex UUID generator -> Save Device ID to localStorage -> Proceed to /home

Start app -> Check localStorage for Device ID -> Device ID missing -> Attempt to save generated Device ID to localStorage -> localStorage write fails -> Show error banner 'Unable to save device ID' -> Present 'Retry' action -> Retry save succeeds or show fallback instructions

features.name: Onboarding Splash Screen
features.description: Mobile-first splash screen with branding and a 15-second auto-navigate timer or manual entry button; must ensure Device ID is initialized before routing to the gallery.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See watercolor illustration and event branding -> Wait 15 seconds -> Ensure Device ID present in localStorage -> Auto-navigate to /home
Navigate to / -> See 'Enter Gallery' button -> Click 'Enter Gallery' button -> Cancel auto-timer -> Ensure Device ID present in localStorage -> Navigate immediately to /home
Navigate to / -> Click 'Enter Gallery' button -> Device ID generation in progress -> Onboarding waits for Device ID initialization -> Device ID saved -> Navigate to /home

Navigate to / -> Wait 15 seconds -> Attempt to navigate to /home -> Device ID generation failed -> Show inline retry control 'Retry Device Init' -> User taps 'Retry' -> Device ID generated and saved -> Navigate to /home

features.name: Live Shared Gallery (Home)
features.description: Realtime or lazy-loaded masonry/grid of uploaded photos showing image, dedication text, and badges; supports switching between Global and Personal views, uploading from device, opening the camera, saving/sharing, and deleting owned photos.
user_flows: Navigate to /home -> See masonry grid populated with global photos and dedications -> Switch tabs to 'Personal' -> See only photos associated with local Device ID
Navigate to /home -> Tap FAB to Open Camera -> App navigates to /camera

Navigate to /home -> Tap Action bar to Upload from device gallery -> File picker opens -> Select file -> App intercepts File and navigates to /camera with File in router state -> See Polaroid preview -> Enter dedication text -> Click Upload photo to gallery -> POST to Supabase storage succeeds -> New photo appears in /home

Navigate to /home -> Click on a photo -> See full photo modal with caption and action buttons -> Click Save/Share -> If navigator.share available -> Native share dialog opens -> User saves to camera roll
Navigate to /home -> Click on a photo -> See full photo modal -> Click Save/Share -> If navigator.share unsupported -> Fallback Blob download triggers via anchor tag -> File downloads to device
Navigate to /home -> Select own photo -> Click Delete -> Confirm deletion -> DELETE to Supabase succeeds -> Photo removed from gallery

Navigate to /home -> Tap Action bar to Upload from device gallery -> File picker opens -> Select file -> App navigates to /camera preview -> Click Upload -> Network error occurs -> Show upload error message with 'Retry' and 'Cancel' actions -> User retries upload or cancels

features.name: Camera Capture & Preview
features.description: In-browser camera capture with front/rear toggle, flash/grid options, Polaroid-style preview, dedication input, local download option, and upload to Supabase; file-input fallback if camera permission denied or unsupported.
user_flows: Navigate to /camera -> Browser prompts for camera permission -> User grants permission -> Camera live view shows
Navigate to /camera -> Double-tap view to flip camera -> Camera switches between front and rear
Navigate to /camera -> Toggle grid overlay -> Grid appears over camera preview
Navigate to /camera -> Toggle flash -> If device Torch API available use hardware flash else perform software screen-brightness flash -> Flash effect observed

Navigate to /camera -> Click shutter button to take photo -> See 'Polaroid' style preview with captured image -> Enter dedication text -> Click Upload photo to gallery -> POST to Supabase storage succeeds -> Return to /home or show success state
Navigate to /camera -> Click shutter button to take photo -> See 'Polaroid' preview -> Click 'Download' -> Browser downloads image blob to device

Navigate to /camera -> Deny camera permission -> App shows file-input fallback -> User selects file from device -> App intercepts File and displays Polaroid preview -> Enter dedication -> Click Upload -> POST to Supabase storage succeeds
Navigate to /camera -> Take photo -> Click Upload -> Upload fails due to storage/CORS error -> Show upload error prompt with 'Retry' -> User retries upload until success or cancels

features.name: Admin View (Gallery Management)
features.description: Authenticated admin route to manage gallery content (review/delete photos); route is protected and requires auth before allowing management actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> App checks authentication -> Authenticated user sees admin gallery list and management controls
Navigate to /admin -> Select photo -> Click Delete -> Confirm deletion -> DELETE to Supabase succeeds -> Photo removed from gallery
Navigate to /admin -> Attempt to access without auth -> App blocks access and redirects to /home or shows 'Unauthorized' message -> Cannot access admin controls
Navigate to /admin -> Delete photo -> DELETE request fails -> Show deletion error message with 'Retry' option -> Admin retries or cancels

known_limitations.issue: Hardware flash gracefully falls back to a software (screen brightness) flash on incompatible mobile browsers.
known_limitations.impact: Flash might be slightly artificial on iOS browsers without Torch API.

known_limitations.issue: Image canvas rendering uses complex CORS handling.
known_limitations.impact: Potential white blanks if DOM ViewChild not initialized before render (addressed via Angular Effects).
